label: D2 after a rare a2->S1 transition
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when state S1 is shown; 99.95% of activation mass is on D2 steps where the agent chose a2 and reached S1 by a rare transition. It never fires at D1 or GO, on S2, or after common a1->S1 (those steps hold 0% of mass and have near-zero activation). The predicate covers nearly all mass (dev recall 0.96, mass recall 1.0), but only about 29% of rare a2->S1 steps activate, so precision is low. Firing rate and magnitude within that set go up when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0: precision 0.46, holds 75% of mass), when S1 is actually the good state (precision 0.56), early in the episode (rate drops steadily from trial 0 to about zero by trials 80-99; with ep_trial<60, F1 0.55 and mass recall 0.86), and when value is low-to-mid and the policy logit favours a2. Recorded predicate uses observed inputs only (the D2 action and state inputs). Its modulators were left out because none of them is a clean cut.
